build_dqn_learner: build a DQN learner using DQNBuilder with Adam optimizer and configurable learning rate
build_dqn_actor: build a DQN actor using DQNBuilder with a variable client for CPU inference
build_replay_tables: build Reverb replay tables with prioritized sampling and FIFO removal for DQN training
build_dqn_policy: build a DQN policy with alternating epsilon greedy exploration using DQNBuilder
build_distributional_dqn_policy: build a distributional DQN policy that extracts Q-values from network head output tuples
